title: Depot depressurisation, 31 July 2020

ground_truth.reason: depot_depressurisation: the unit is parked and the system is vented on purpose, so the low-pressure switch is right and there is nothing to diagnose

notes: The canonical hard negative: the longest LPS episode of the recording, 01:35:33 to 06:04:16, with no leak behind it. The failure table marks it excluded, so nothing raised inside it is scored; what the scenario watches is the hour before and the two hours after, where a detector that reads the vent as a fault would open a ticket.
